blueprint.concept: A moonlit haunted hall: learn to dash over wide gaps and wall-jump up cliffs, dodging pumpkins and bats.
Climb the haunted tower by wall jumps and upward dashes while ghosts creep up behind you.

objects/def_ed00766789b1.json.name: Platform
objects/def_ed00766789b1.json.description: A square ground tile. Draw rows of them to build platforms.

objects/def_541435bab161.json.name: Stone
objects/def_541435bab161.json.description: A square stone tile for walls, ledges and floors.

objects/def_86ee26dd933d.json.name: Ladder
objects/def_86ee26dd933d.json.description: A ladder segment. Draw a column of them to make a ladder of any height.

objects/def_8d6451cb88e9.json.name: Pumpkin
objects/def_8d6451cb88e9.json.description: A basic enemy that hurts on contact and is defeated by jumping on it. It patrols near where it starts (sometimes up or down a ladder) and chases the player once it sees it, slowing down before it turns around.

scripts.name: Stomp
scripts.description: Jumping on it from above defeats it; whoever jumped bounces off unhurt.

scripts.name: Hurts on touch
scripts.description: Touching it hurts player (1 health a hit).

scripts.name: Walker
scripts.description: Keeps walking the same way until it hits a wall or another enemy, then turns around (Goomba-like). With turn_at_ledges it turns at the end of a platform instead of walking off it.

do.cond: self.bumped == dir or wall_ahead(dir, 0) or (turn_at_enemies and thing_at(self.x + dir * (self.width / 2 + 3), self.y, 'enemy')) or (turn_at_ledges and self.grounded and ledge_ahead(dir))

objects/def_0d3c3c82bcd2.json.name: Key
objects/def_0d3c3c82bcd2.json.description: A key to pick up. Doors can require it.

objects/def_2e6bb61414e8.json.name: Door
objects/def_2e6bb61414e8.json.description: A door that blocks the way until it is opened (by a switch, a key or a rule).

objects/def_f791e4e9483f.json.name: Switch
objects/def_f791e4e9483f.json.description: A lever. Press E next to it to flip it. Make it control a door.

objects/def_701ee8ed7e60.json.name: Hazard
objects/def_701ee8ed7e60.json.description: Spikes, one tile wide: damages anything that touches it. Draw a row of them for longer spikes.

scripts.name: Hurts on touch
scripts.description: Touching it hurts anything with health (1 health a hit).

objects/def_2d51cb45230c.json.name: Teleporter
objects/def_2d51cb45230c.json.description: A teleporter pad. Connect two with "teleports to" (each way for a two-way pair): stepping on one puts the player on the other.

objects/def_1f64302bac4f.json.name: Goal
objects/def_1f64302bac4f.json.description: The level goal: reaching it wins the level (play goes on to the next level).

objects/def_20513d11ab3e.json.name: Crate
objects/def_20513d11ab3e.json.description: A heavy crate the player can push sideways, slowly (it falls off ledges); stand on it to reach higher.

objects/def_2e1d46972399.json.name: Ramp
objects/def_2e1d46972399.json.description: A 45 degree ramp rising to the right: walked up and down. Stand it on the ground with the ground going on, level with its top, on its right.

objects/def_84415f7fcdc8.json.name: Ramp left
objects/def_84415f7fcdc8.json.description: A 45 degree ramp rising to the left: walked up and down. Stand it on the ground with the ground going on, level with its top, on its left.

objects/def_d4a781b4f62e.json.name: Bridge
objects/def_d4a781b4f62e.json.description: A plank bridge, a jump-through platform: the player lands on it from above and jumps up through it from below (Down + Jump drops through). Draw rows of it across gaps, level with the ground.

objects/def_5c4e833a0b96.json.name: Water
objects/def_5c4e833a0b96.json.description: The surface of water, its waves moving, drawn see-through in front of whoever swims in it: the player swims in it (Jump strokes up) and jumps out at the top. The top row of a pool; Deep water under it.

objects/def_46d94ecd8027.json.name: Deep water
objects/def_46d94ecd8027.json.description: Water under the surface (the Water row): fills a pool below it.

objects/def_6b1df8c7094d.json.name: Spring
objects/def_6b1df8c7094d.json.description: A spring (or a bouncy mushroom, a bubble…) on the floor: a half-jump bounce; holding Jump on it launches the player two jumps high.

scripts.name: Spring
scripts.description: Bounces the player half a jump high, or two jumps high holding Jump. Coming down on it bounces anything with a Character Controller half its jump; holding Jump as the player lands (or pressing it just before or after) launches it twice its jump. Settings: bounce and launch (in the player's own jumps), timing (how close to landing a press of Jump still launches).

do.cond: has_tag(other, "player") and (key("jump") or time - pressed_at < timing)

handlers.if: time < launch_until and pressed("jump") and exists(player)

objects/def_8d590ac0b12e.json.name: Question block
objects/def_8d590ac0b12e.json.description: A ? block: jumping up into it from below gives a Coin on top, once. Two empty cells under it.

scripts.name: Question block
scripts.description: Gives a Coin when the player bumps it from below, then shows its used look (SpriteStates.used). times: how many bumps give one.

objects/def_7b1c3c9fa4c1.json.name: Brick
objects/def_7b1c3c9fa4c1.json.description: A brick block: jumping up into it from below breaks it.

scripts.name: Brick block
scripts.description: Breaks when the player bumps it from below.

objects/def_780047d92bda.json.name: Pipe top
objects/def_780047d92bda.json.description: The top of a pipe, two cells wide: on the ground or on Pipe pieces.

objects/def_094cf0061c9f.json.name: Pipe
objects/def_094cf0061c9f.json.description: Pipe going down, two cells wide, under a Pipe top.

objects/def_88cffb42a9ef.json.name: Heart
objects/def_88cffb42a9ef.json.description: A heart: picking it up gives back one heart of health (up to the most the player can have). Its look is also the look of the player's hearts on the screen.

objects/def_55fc718d15d0.json.name: Pressure plate
objects/def_55fc718d15d0.json.description: A pressure plate on the floor: on while the player or a crate stands on it, off when it leaves. Make it control a door: the door is open only while the plate is held down (push a crate onto it to keep it open).

scripts.name: Pressure plate
scripts.description: On while the player or a crate (anything tagged pushable or crate) is on it, off when it leaves: "switch_activated" happens each time, so what it controls opens while it is held down and closes after. Shows its used look (SpriteStates.used) while pressed.

objects/def_7f63b24ae07a.json.name: Bat
objects/def_7f63b24ae07a.json.description: A purple bat that flies in waves; jump on it to defeat it.

scripts.name: Wave flyer
scripts.description: Flies one way, bobbing up and down in a wave (a bat, a flying fish); turns at walls and after distance pixels from where it started (0 = only at walls). Nothing pulls it down.

do.cond: self.bumped == dir or wall_ahead(dir, 0) or (distance > 0 and (self.x - self.spawn_x) * dir >= distance)

scripts.name: Stomp
scripts.description: Jumping on it from above defeats it; whoever jumped bounces off unhurt.

scripts.name: Hurts on touch
scripts.description: Touching it hurts player (1 health a hit).

objects/def_497aad551655.json.name: Ghost
objects/def_497aad551655.json.description: A shy ghost: drifts toward the player while it looks away, freezes when faced.

scripts.name: Shy ghost
scripts.description: Floats toward the player through the air while the player looks the other way, and stops still while the player faces it (Boo-like). Only within range pixels (0 = anywhere). Nothing pulls it down.

do.cond: nearest_player() and (range <= 0 or dist(nearest_player()) <= range) and nearest_player().facing != sign(self.x - nearest_player().x)

scripts.name: Hurts on touch
scripts.description: Touching it hurts player (1 health a hit).

objects/def_86ae773d3f2a.json.name: Floating shelf
objects/def_86ae773d3f2a.json.description: A haunted shelf that glides back and forth, carrying whoever stands on it.

entries.request: make me a cool platformer with fresh enemies and a hip player that can dash and wall jump
entries.message: I built two levels for your haunted platformer. They have gaps you can only cross by dashing, walls you climb with wall jumps, moving shelves and the new pumpkins, bats and ghosts. Press X to dash, and press Jump against a wall to wall jump.
changes: Player: new kid look (running and jumping poses), can dash (X) and wall jump
Pumpkin (the old Enemy): walks and turns at ledges, glowing face; you can still jump on it
Bat (new): flies in waves, can be stomped
Ghost (new): sneaks up while the player looks away, freezes when faced
Floating shelf (new): a glowing moving platform
Ground: purple stone bricks that join up at the edges
Bridge, Ladder, Coin, Key, Door, Spikes, Goal portal: new haunted looks
Background: night sky with a moon; game set as a classic haunted platformer
Kind: classic haunted platformer with solid stone, jump-through planks, ladders, spikes and a spirit portal at the end of each level

Level 1, "Moonlit Halls": a medium run from left to right. It starts easy, then brings in dashing, wall jumping and moving shelves, with pumpkins and bats along the way and a hidden coin stash up high
Level 2, "The Haunted Tower": a harder climb up stacked floors, with wall-jump shafts, dashes up cliffs, ghosts and bats, and a risky shortcut beside a safer way
Level 2: night sky with a moon behind it

⚠ Left out one part that couldn't be applied: There is no placed object with id "scn_88018cb257b0" (use the ids in targets and otherEntities of this level; to add something, place_instance its object)
⚠ Not checked: whether the player gets everywhere. Its wall jumps and dashes aren't judged by the jump checker, which alone can't get it to everything; play it to see.

entries.request: The player is not on the screen when the game starts. I think the camera is not fitting the screen so the edges are outsidewhat the user sees
entries.message: I set the camera so every level now fits the screen. The whole height of Level 1 is always on screen, it stays inside the level's edges, and it follows the player from the first moment. The taller levels show the same amount of height and scroll up and down with the player.
changes: Level 1 camera: fits the whole level's height on screen, stays inside the level
The Haunted Tower, Level 3, Level 4 cameras: show 15 tiles top to bottom, stay inside the level
